headline: Airtel Africa initiates second tranche of share buyback
summary: Airtel Africa Plc has commenced the second tranche of its share buyback program, which was originally announced in May 2026.
why: Share buybacks are a method for companies to return capital to shareholders and often signal management's confidence in the company's financial position.

impacts.name: Airtel Africa
impacts.why: Buybacks reduce share supply, which can support share prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
